title.zh: 【路透社：德意志银行数周内将在德国推出加密托管服务，明年拓展至亚洲】
title.en: 【路透社：德意志银行数周内将在德国推出加密托管服务，明年拓展至亚洲】

current_state.zh: Deutsche Bank says it will launch a digital asset custody service in Germany within weeks, initially covering BTC and ETH with stablecoin on/off-ramp services to follow, and plans to expand the platform to Asian financial centres next year alongside tokenized deposits and blockchain-based digital bond issuance.
current_state.en: Deutsche Bank says it will launch a digital asset custody service in Germany within weeks, initially covering BTC and ETH with stablecoin on/off-ramp services to follow, and plans to expand the platform to Asian financial centres next year alongside tokenized deposits and blockchain-based digital bond issuance.
